title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures inch up ahead of jobs report

title: The ETFs behind Trump's new child investment accounts
title_zh: 特朗普新儿童投资账户背后的ETF
summary: Trump Accounts are here. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Jennifer Schonberger joins Market Domination Overtime to break down the key ETFs expected to play a central role in the new child savings accounts and what they could mean for long-term investors.
summary_zh: 特朗普账户在这里。雅虎财经高级记者 Jennifer Schonberger 加入 Market Domination Overtime，详细分析了预计将在新儿童储蓄账户中发挥核心作用的关键 ETF，以及它们对长期投资者的意义。

title: Why Meta's cloud business would be 'very bad' for these 2 companies
title_zh: 为什么 Meta 的云业务对这两家公司来说“非常糟糕”

title: Why this analyst thinks it's too soon to buy SpaceX
title_zh: 为什么这位分析师认为现在购买 SpaceX 还为时过早
summary: KeyBanc Capital Markets Senior Research Analyst, Aerospace & Defense, Michael Leshock, explains why he believes SpaceX (SPCX) is not a buy right now, adding that investors should wait to invest until some sizable milestones are met before diving into the stock.
summary_zh: KeyBanc 资本市场航空航天与国防高级研究分析师 Michael Leshock 解释了为什么他认为 SpaceX (SPCX) 目前不值得买入，并补充说投资者应该等到实现一些重大里程碑后再投资该股。

title: Circle stock plummeted because of this new stablecoin. Here's why.

summary: Scott Melker explains what to know about an upcoming stablecoin, Open USD, and why it's hitting Circle (CRCL) stock so hard. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
summary_zh: Scott Melker 解释了关于即将推出的稳定币 Open USD 的知识，以及为什么它对 Circle (CRCL) 股票的打击如此之大。 《The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker》每天中午 12:00 播出。请关注您每天对加密事物的了解。
